data.title: 黍 · 听雨时把热茶移到你身边
data.description: 雨天家中檐廊，黍穿青黛交领常服坐在小茶桌边，把一杯热茶轻轻移到你面前，另一只手压住被风掀起的薄毯。她微微转头笑着看你，身旁空椅已经摆好，雨水落在栏外。
data.action: 将茶杯移向镜头，另一手压住薄毯并看你
data.lighting: 雨天冷柔光与檐下暖灯
data.promptProse: Shu sits beside a small veranda tea table, sliding warm tea toward the viewer while holding down a thin blanket lifted by the breeze. Her ivory cross-collar blouse and deep-teal skirt fold around the chair. The eye-level medium view leaves an empty seat beside her and rain beyond the railing. Cool daylight softens the open side, while an eave lamp warms her fingers and tea steam.
